description: This file defines the SigfoxProtocolAdapter class, which is a Vert.x based HTTP protocol adapter for handling Sigfox device communications, including data uploads and command handling within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: SigfoxProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x based HTTP protocol adapter for Sigfox devices, supporting data uploads, command responses, and request authentication.

classes.name: UploadHandler
classes.description: Functional interface for handling message uploads.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for authenticating devices via username and password.

methods.name: setTenantObjectWithAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider to determine tenant and auth ID from the request context.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of this protocol adapter.

methods.name: setupAuthorization
methods.description: Configures authentication handlers for the router.

methods.name: getTenantTraceSamplingHandler
methods.description: Provides handler for tracing and tenant identification.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Defines HTTP routes for telemetry and event data.

methods.name: dataCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates CORS handler for data endpoints.

methods.name: dataHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming data requests, verifies tenant/device info, and invokes upload handler.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Adds Sigfox-specific properties to downstream messages.

methods.name: decodeData
methods.description: Decodes base16-encoded data string into a Buffer.

methods.name: getTimeUntilDisconnectFromRequest
methods.description: Determines the time until disconnection based on request parameters.

methods.name: isCommandValid
methods.description: Validates command parameters including payload size and type.

methods.name: setEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets a response with no content for acknowledgments.

methods.name: setNonEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets a response with a JSON payload for command responses.

methods.name: convertToResponsePayload
methods.description: Converts a Command object into a JSON Buffer for response.
